chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.desc: Versatile conversational AI for drafting, brainstorming, and structuring content. Highly responsive to detailed prompts.

claude.name: Claude
claude.desc: Excellent for long-form synthesis, nuanced rewriting, and following complex multi-step instructions. Handles large documents well.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.desc: Multimodal AI with deep Google/Drive integration. Good for research summaries, multimedia prompts, and slides.

copilot.name: Microsoft Copilot
copilot.desc: Integrated into Microsoft 365. Ideal for Word drafts, Teams summaries, and productivity workflows faculty already use.

perplexity.name: Perplexity AI
perplexity.desc: Search-first AI that cites its sources. Best for quick literature scans, fact-checking, and verifiable research overviews.

notebooklm.name: NotebookLM
notebooklm.desc: Upload YOUR documents; Google's AI summarizes, connects themes, and answers questions grounded in your sources. No hallucination of outside content.

semscholar.name: Semantic Scholar
semscholar.desc: AI-powered scholarly search with citation graphs and influence scores. Essential for tracking research lineages.

elicit.name: Elicit
elicit.desc: Automates literature review by extracting methods, findings, and sample sizes from papers into structured tables.

scite.name: Scite
scite.desc: Shows exactly how a paper is cited -- supporting, contrasting, or simply mentioning. Critical for evaluating evidence claims.

resrabbit.name: ResearchRabbit
resrabbit.desc: Visually maps citation networks around seed papers. Perfect for entering a new field or finding influential authors fast.

julius.name: Julius AI
julius.desc: Upload a dataset; Julius provides AI-assisted analysis, charts, and interpretation. Always validate statistical outputs independently.

grammarly.name: Grammarly
grammarly.desc: AI writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and style. Good scaffolding tool for student writing without full text generation.

midjourney.name: Midjourney
midjourney.desc: High-quality AI image generation with strong aesthetic control. Excellent for visual course materials, concept illustrations, and media projects.

dalle.name: DALL-E 3
dalle.desc: Image generation built into ChatGPT. Good for quick concept diagrams, illustrative teaching materials, and accessible alt-text creation.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.desc: Realistic AI voice generation for narrated course content, accessibility audio, and language learning materials.

runway.name: Runway
runway.desc: AI video generation and editing tools. Useful for short explainer clips, concept visualizations, and creative media assignments.

otter.name: Otter.ai
otter.desc: AI transcription and auto-generated meeting notes. Useful for recording office hours, lectures, or research interviews for accessibility.

rayyan.name: Rayyan
rayyan.desc: Systematic review management. 90% time savings on screening.

connectedpapers.name: Connected Papers
connectedpapers.desc: Visual citation networks. Find influential works and gaps.

anara.name: Anara
anara.desc: Search PubMed, arXiv, JSTOR. Chat with documents.

chatpdf.name: ChatPDF
chatpdf.desc: Ask questions, get answers from PDF documents.

kling.name: Kling AI
kling.desc: AI video generation platform with text-to-video, image-to-video, and motion brush tools. Strong cinematic quality with free tier available.

lumaai.name: Luma AI
lumaai.desc: Dream Machine generates fast AI video (5-10 sec) from text or images. Great for storyboards and quick animations.

suno.name: Suno
suno.desc: AI music and song generation from text prompts. Create original audio for projects, podcasts, presentations.

firefly.name: Adobe Firefly
firefly.desc: Commercial-safe AI image generation integrated with Adobe Creative Cloud. Professional graphics and marketing materials.

stablediff.name: Stable Diffusion
stablediff.desc: Open-source image generation. Highly customizable for technical users, research on AI art, custom model training.

synthesia.name: Synthesia
synthesia.desc: AI avatar video creation. Generate lecture videos with realistic presenters in 140+ languages. Accessibility-focused.

consensus.name: Consensus
consensus.desc: AI-powered academic search engine that extracts findings from scientific papers. Shows whether research supports or refutes claims with meter visualization.

pubmed.name: PubMed.ai
pubmed.desc: AI-assisted biomedical literature search and research workflow platform. Adds summaries, structured analysis, and MeSH-aware retrieval on top of PubMed-referenced biomedical literature.

veo.name: Google Veo
veo.desc: Google's flagship AI video generator with native audio, 4K output, and vertical video support. Integrated into Gemini app, YouTube Shorts, and Google Vids. Strong physics simulation and character consistency.

magicschool.name: MagicSchool AI
magicschool.desc: AI platform built by educators for educators. 60+ tools for lesson planning, rubric generation, differentiation, IEP support, and teaching/course AI. Trusted by 5M+ teachers. FERPA/COPPA compliant.

pika.name: Pika
pika.desc: AI video generator for short-form educational and creative content. Text-to-video, image-to-video, and creative Pikaffects VFX tools. Good for quick explainer clips and visual demonstrations.
